inputs.text: Pinarayi Vijayan’s denial of the Rs 700 crore corruption allegations surrounding the Cooperative Department’s proposed common software project doesn’t clear things up. Calling the questions “political” seems like a way to discredit scrutiny before anyone can trace where the money and benefits might lead. The real story may be who wants this project—and the questions around it—to remain out of view.
